Sony 3.5 Inch Micro Floppy Disk 2HD 1.44MB Sealed Bundle 9 Packs x10 Disks
This listing includes a bundle of nine sealed packs of Sony Micro Floppy Disks, model 10MFD-2HDcf. Each pack contains 10 double-sided, high-density 3.5-inch floppy disks formatted for IBM systems, with a storage capacity of 1.44MB per disk. These disks are compatible with IBM and IBM-compatible 3.5" 2HD drive systems such as Compaq, Dell, HP, Gateway, and various laptops. The packaging highlights Sony's special cleaning mechanism and multi-use removable labels. Each pack is new, unopened, and comes with a full lifetime warranty. This sealed Sony floppy disks bundle is suitable for vintage computer collectors or users requiring genuine media for legacy systems.

281355253.description:
2.8lb Bulk Lot Natural Crystals Gemstones Polished Stones Rough Minerals
Bulk lot of assorted natural crystals and gemstones totaling approximately 2.8 lbs. Includes polished heart-shaped stones such as rose quartz, ruby zoisite, howlite, green aventurine/fluorite, jasper, and a pink-and-black mineral. Contains a tumbled labradorite beaded stretch bracelet, rose quartz point/wand, small druzy quartz geode, and multiple raw mineral specimens including amethyst, amazonite, citrine, apatite, calcite, and clear quartz points. Stones range from small chips to palm-sized pieces with finishes from polished and glossy to natural raw surfaces. Colors include pink, green, white, purple, blue, orange, black, and gray with visible natural veining and mineral inclusions. Items are new and unused, suitable for crystal healing, jewelry making, display, or collecting. Packaged in a labeled Ziploc bag.
